title: Propagate rejected OpenArt Mira frame proof into FAILED Instagram obligation and canonical Brain
root_cause: The existing recordMediaProofRejection updates the canonical content_publication_obligations diagnostic only for BLOCKED, but the watchdog has already transitioned the same publication obligation to FAILED. The WAITING_PROOF job was therefore fresher than the FAILED obligation. No independent explanation for the underlying sub-0.94 face-score variation is proven.
impact: Two components of the same daily Instagram job expose inconsistent failure causes; agents may needlessly repeat media generation. Historical attempts=108 does not imply 108 unique provider videos.

evidence.production_data_reconciliation: Existing FAILED obligation updated to exact 0.930 rejection while remaining FAILED with external_id=NULL at 2026-10-22T18:57:46Z

fix: Use status-specific CAS for both FAILED/BLOCKED read-model diagnostics and append first unique OpenArt history/frame rejection to existing brain_observe_failure (no new table or scheduler). Preserve job status, failed public status, media URL, and provider ID truth.
prevention_rule: On every exact OpenArt Mira frame rejection, dedupe by generation/frame and append canonical Brain occurrence; reconcile FAILED/BLOCKED read-model diagnostics under CAS; never erase verified rejection or mark Instagram live without >=0.94 start/middle/end identity, temporal match and independent provider readback.
release_gates: Supabase Edge router exact source readback
outcome: CANDIDATE; diagnostic data reconciled, code not production-deployed until gates succeed. Instagram publication remains FAILED.
